InvoiceClaimViewDescription: This view aggregates sales data of eligible product for a specific promotion.
InvoiceClaimView:
SELECT
  "eligibleProductRewards"."reward",
  "eligibleProductRewards"."productAttributeValue",
  "sales"."userId",
  "users"."username",
  "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId",
  SUM("sales"."quantity") AS "totalSalesQuantity",
  SUM("sales"."value") AS "totalSalesValue"
FROM
  "users" AS "users"
  INNER JOIN "vw_promotion_eligible_audience" AS "vw_promotion_eligible_audience" ON (
    "users"."id" = "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId"
  )
  INNER JOIN "sales" AS "sales" ON (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId" = "sales"."userId"
  )
  INNER JOIN "products" AS "products" ON (
    "sales"."productId" = "products"."id"
  )
  INNER JOIN "eligibleProductRewards" AS "eligibleProductRewards" ON (
    "products"."externalIdentifier" = "eligibleProductRewards"."productAttributeValue"
    AND "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = "eligibleProductRewards"."promotionId"
  )
  INNER JOIN "invoiceClaimSubmissions" AS "invoiceClaimSubmissions" ON (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId" = "invoiceClaimSubmissions"."userId"
  )
WHERE
  (
    "eligibleProductRewards"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
    AND "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
  )
  AND ("invoiceClaimSubmissions"."status" = 'approved')
  AND ("sales"."origin" = 'evidenceBasedClaim')
GROUP BY
  "eligibleProductRewards"."reward",
  "eligibleProductRewards"."productAttributeValue",
  "sales"."userId",
  "users"."username",
  "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId"
